# Lumora: Brand Story, Philosophy, and Core Rituals

[Lumora | Lumora: Brand Story, Philosophy, and Core Rituals | 1. Brand Identity & Origins]
Lumora was founded with a singular conviction: healthy skin does not require a chaotic ten-step regimen. Born out of modern dermatology research and formulated specifically for the diverse environmental conditions of Egypt and the Mediterranean climate—ranging from dry urban heat in Cairo to coastal humidity in Alexandria—Lumora curates minimalist, high-efficacy skincare rituals.
Our tagline, *"Radiance, simplified."*, guides every formulation. We replace vanity fillers with clean, clinically validated, biocompatible actives that honor the skin's natural barrier.

[Lumora | Lumora: Brand Story, Philosophy, and Core Rituals | 2. Our Formulation Principles]
- **Minimalist Purity:** Every formula contains only ingredients that serve a direct cellular or barrier-support purpose. No synthetic dyes, no artificial fragrances, and no denatured drying alcohols.
- **Microbiome & Barrier Centric:** We prioritize ceramides, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and panthenol to shield the skin against environmental pollutants and harsh UV exposure.
- **Ethical & Cruelty-Free:** Lumora is 100% cruelty-free. We never test on animals, and our suppliers adhere to strict ethical sourcing standards.
- **Hypoallergenic Standard:** All finished batches undergo dermatological patch testing under clinical supervision.

section: 3. Brand Voice and Customer Interaction Philosophy
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Brand Story, Philosophy, and Core Rituals | 3. Brand Voice and Customer Interaction Philosophy]
When communicating with our patrons, the Lumora voice must always remain:
- **Calm and Reassuring:** Speak with gentle confidence. Patrons often come to us feeling frustrated with breakouts or barrier damage; our language should bring peace.
- **Scientifically Mindful:** Explain ingredient functions simply without medical jargon or overpromising miracles.
- **Empathetic & Transparent:** Never disguise policy limitations. Explain rules with sincere care for public hygiene and personal skin safety.

# Lumora: Shipping, Delivery Timelines, and Order Tracking Policy

[Lumora | Lumora: Shipping, Delivery Timelines, and Order Tracking Policy | 1. Shipping Coverage & Domestic Courier Partners]
Lumora ships domestically to all governorates across the Arab Republic of Egypt via trusted local courier logistics (Bosta, Aramex, and specialized temperature-regulated domestic carriers).

section: 2. Standard Shipping Times and Delivery Windows
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Shipping, Delivery Timelines, and Order Tracking Policy | 2. Standard Shipping Times and Delivery Windows]
- **Greater Cairo & Giza (including New Cairo, 6th of October, Sheikh Zayed, Maadi, Nasr City, Heliopolis):**
  - Standard Delivery: 1 to 2 business days.
  - Express Same-Day Option: Available for orders confirmed before 12:00 PM (Cairo Time) at an additional premium.
- **Alexandria and Delta Governorates (Tanta, Mansoura, Zagazig, Damanhour):**
  - Standard Delivery: 2 to 3 business days.
- **Canal Cities (Port Said, Ismailia, Suez):**
  - Standard Delivery: 2 to 3 business days.
- **Upper Egypt (Beni Suef, Minya, Asyut, Sohag, Qena, Luxor, Aswan):**
  - Standard Delivery: 3 to 5 business days.
- **Red Sea & Frontier Regions (Hurghada, Sharm El Sheikh, Marsa Matrouh, North/South Sinai):**
  - Standard Delivery: 4 to 6 business days.
*Note: Business days are Sunday through Thursday. Orders placed on Friday, Saturday, or national public holidays are processed the following business day.*

[Lumora | Lumora: Shipping, Delivery Timelines, and Order Tracking Policy | 3. Shipping Rates & Free Shipping Thresholds]
- **Flat Rate Standard Shipping (Cairo & Giza):** 45 EGP.
- **Flat Rate Standard Shipping (Alexandria & Delta):** 60 EGP.
- **Flat Rate Standard Shipping (Upper Egypt & Red Sea):** 75 EGP.
- **Complimentary Free Shipping:** All domestic orders exceeding **800 EGP** qualify for automatic free standard shipping across all governorates.

section: 4. Order Confirmation, Dispatch, and Real-Time Tracking
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Shipping, Delivery Timelines, and Order Tracking Policy | 4. Order Confirmation, Dispatch, and Real-Time Tracking]
- Upon placing an order, patrons receive an instant SMS and email confirmation containing a unique synthetic order reference (format: `LUM-XXXX`, e.g., `LUM-1042`).
- When the order is packed and dispatched from our temperature-controlled central fulfillment hub in Cairo, a live tracking link with the courier tracking code is sent via WhatsApp and SMS.
- Couriers make up to 3 delivery attempts before returning the parcel to our hub. Patrons may reschedule delivery windows directly with the courier dispatch team.

[Lumora | Lumora: Official Return, Exchange, and Refund Policy | Overview]
# Lumora: Official Return, Exchange, and Refund Policy

[Lumora | Lumora: Official Return, Exchange, and Refund Policy | 1. Core Return & Exchange Policy Window]
At Lumora, we stand behind the integrity and gentle formulation of our skincare rituals. We accept return and exchange requests submitted within **14 calendar days** from the verified courier delivery date.

[Lumora | Lumora: Official Return, Exchange, and Refund Policy | 2. Eligibility & Public Health Hygiene Standards]
Cosmetics, topical serums, and dermatological formulations are subject to strict health and safety regulations in accordance with Egyptian consumer protection standards.
To qualify for a standard return or exchange (due to change of mind or personal preference):
1. **Unopened and Factory-Sealed:** The product must remain completely unopened, unused, and with the tamper-evident metallic/plastic seal fully intact.
2. **Original Packaging:** The item must be returned in its original cardboard unit carton with all batch codes, labels, and protective caps undamaged.
3. **Proof of Purchase:** Valid order reference number (`LUM-XXXX`) or digital receipt.

[Lumora | Lumora: Official Return, Exchange, and Refund Policy | 3. Strictly Non-Returnable Items]
For public hygiene, safety, and cross-contamination prevention, the following items **cannot** be returned or exchanged under any circumstances:
- Any skincare bottle, jar, dropper, or pump that has been opened, unsealed, or tested.
- Discovery kits, travel sample bundles, or complimentary promotional gifts.
- Digital or physical Lumora gift cards.

section: 4. Exceptions: Defective Items and Incorrect Deliveries
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Official Return, Exchange, and Refund Policy | 4. Exceptions: Defective Items and Incorrect Deliveries]
We take full responsibility for packaging flaws or fulfillment discrepancies:
- **Damaged or Defective on Arrival:** If an item arrives with broken glass, a defective airless pump dispenser, or compromised packaging during courier transit, it is fully eligible for an immediate free replacement or full refund, even if unboxed. Patrons are requested to provide photographic evidence within 48 hours of delivery.
- **Incorrect Item Delivered:** If you received a product different from what you ordered, Lumora will dispatch the correct item via express courier and retrieve the incorrect unit at zero shipping expense to you.

section: 5. Sensitive Case Protocol: Allergic Reactions and Irritation
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Official Return, Exchange, and Refund Policy | 5. Sensitive Case Protocol: Allergic Reactions and Irritation]
Skin biology is deeply individual. In the rare event that a patron experiences an adverse reaction, allergic flare-up, or acute irritation upon testing an authorized product:
- The automated AI assistant **must not attempt automated policy resolution**.
- The inquiry is immediately escalated to our Senior Care and Dermatological Consultation Team.
- Our team will review the incident, provide soothing usage guidance, and coordinate an empathetic resolution (including specialized refunds or product substitutions).

[Lumora | Lumora: Official Return, Exchange, and Refund Policy | 6. Refund Procedures and Payout Channels]
Once returned items arrive at our fulfillment hub, our quality control team inspects packaging and seal integrity within 48 hours:
- **Credit/Debit Card Payments:** Refunds are credited back to the original card within 5 to 10 banking days (subject to issuing bank processing times).
- **Cash on Delivery (COD) Orders:** Refunds are disbursed electronically via **InstaPay**, **Vodafone Cash / Mobile Wallets**, or direct domestic Egyptian bank wire within 3 business days following successful inspection.
- Standard return courier fee of 45 EGP is deducted from change-of-mind returns, but completely waived for defective items or order fulfillment errors.

# Lumora: Skincare Rituals, Application Sequencing, and Skin Profiles

[Lumora | Lumora: Skincare Rituals, Application Sequencing, and Skin Profiles | 1. The Lumora 4-Step Baseline Ritual]
We recommend a streamlined four-step ritual for sustained epidermal health:
1. **Cleanse:** Remove impurities without stripping the natural lipid mantle. Use lukewarm water; never hot water, which triggers vascular flushing.
2. **Prep & Tone:** Balance epidermal pH and enhance subsequent active penetration using hydrating, alcohol-free essences.
3. **Target (Serums):** Apply high-efficacy concentrated bio-actives to address specific skin concerns (e.g. barrier restoration, pigmentation, dehydration).
4. **Lock & Protect:** Seal moisture with biomimetic lipid creams. In morning rituals, always finish with broad-spectrum SPF 50+ mineral or hybrid sunscreen.

[Lumora | Lumora: Skincare Rituals, Application Sequencing, and Skin Profiles | 2. Product Layering Principles]
- **Thinnest to Thickest:** Apply water-soluble, low-viscosity products first (toners, essences), followed by light serums (hyaluronic acid, niacinamide), emulsion serums (vitamin C, retinoids), creams, and finally facial oils or sunscreens.
- **Active Separation:**
  - *Retinoids & Direct Acids (AHA/BHA):* Do not combine on the same evening to avoid barrier compromise. Alternate evenings.
  - *Vitamin C & Niacinamide:* Lumora's stabilized Vitamin C serum is buffered to be fully compatible with our Niacinamide serum, but sensitive skin types may prefer applying Vitamin C in the morning and Niacinamide in the evening.

section: 3. Recommendations by Skin Concern & Climate in Egypt
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Skincare Rituals, Application Sequencing, and Skin Profiles | 3. Recommendations by Skin Concern & Climate in Egypt]
- **Oily and Blemish-Prone Skin (Humid Summer Weather):**
  - Gentle Salicylic Acid Clarifying Gel Cleanser.
  - 10% Niacinamide + Zinc 1% Oil-Control Serum.
  - Ultra-lightweight Hydro-Water Gel Moisturizer.
- **Dry, Dehydrated, or Barrier-Impaired Skin (Air-Conditioned or Winter Environments):**
  - Ceramide Hydrating Cream Cleanser.
  - 2% Multi-Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum.
  - 5-Ceramide Barrier Repair Recovery Cream.
- **Sensitive and Reactive Skin:**
  - Centella Asiatica & Panthenol Soothing Mist.
  - Calming Oat Lipid Barrier Serum.
  - Fragrance-free Mineral Sheer Shield SPF 50+.

section: 4. The Golden Rule of Patch Testing
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Skincare Rituals, Application Sequencing, and Skin Profiles | 4. The Golden Rule of Patch Testing]
We advise all patrons to perform a 24-hour patch test before introducing any active formulation:
1. Apply a dime-sized drop behind the ear or on the inner forearm.
2. Allow to absorb and leave unwashed for 24 hours.
3. If no redness, itching, burning, or swelling occurs, safely introduce the product into your facial ritual, starting 2 to 3 times weekly.

[Lumora | Lumora: Ingredients Transparency, Pregnancy Safety, and Product FAQs | Overview]
# Lumora: Ingredients Transparency, Pregnancy Safety, and Product FAQs

section: Q1: Are Lumora products safe for pregnant and nursing mothers?
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Ingredients Transparency, Pregnancy Safety, and Product FAQs | Q1: Are Lumora products safe for pregnant and nursing mothers?]
Most Lumora hydrating, soothing, and barrier-repair formulations (Hyaluronic Acid Serum, Ceramide Cream, Centella Mist, Mineral SPF) are formulated without teratogenic ingredients and are considered safe during pregnancy.
**Important Exception:** Products containing *Retinoids / Retinol* or high concentrations of *Salicylic Acid (BHA > 1%)* should be avoided during pregnancy and lactation. Always consult your personal OB/GYN before starting active skincare treatments.

section: Q2: What is the shelf life and Period After Opening (PAO)?
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Ingredients Transparency, Pregnancy Safety, and Product FAQs | Q2: What is the shelf life and Period After Opening (PAO)?]
- **Unopened Shelf Life:** All Lumora products have an unopened shelf life of 24 months from the manufacturing batch date printed on the bottom of the carton.
- **Period After Opening (PAO):** Indicated by the open-jar icon on the container:
  - Serums with active antioxidants (Vitamin C, Retinol): 6 months after opening.
  - Hydrating cleansers, toners, and moisturizers: 12 months after opening.
  - Sunscreens: 12 months after opening.

section: Q3: How should Lumora products be stored in hot Egyptian summers?
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Ingredients Transparency, Pregnancy Safety, and Product FAQs | Q3: How should Lumora products be stored in hot Egyptian summers?]
Store products in a cool, dry area away from direct sunlight and excessive humidity. Room temperatures below 25°C are ideal. Avoid leaving serums on sunlit window sills or in hot vehicles. Serums like Pure Vitamin C and Soothing Toners may be stored in a skincare refrigerator (8°C to 12°C) for an enhanced de-puffing sensory experience.

section: Q4: Are your products non-comedogenic and vegan?
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Ingredients Transparency, Pregnancy Safety, and Product FAQs | Q4: Are your products non-comedogenic and vegan?]
Yes. 100% of Lumora formulations are tested to be non-comedogenic (meaning they do not clog pore channels) and do not contain animal derivatives, beeswax, or lanolin. We are strictly cruelty-free and vegan-certified.

section: Q5: What should I do if a product separates or changes color slightly?
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Ingredients Transparency, Pregnancy Safety, and Product FAQs | Q5: What should I do if a product separates or changes color slightly?]
Because Lumora uses minimal artificial stabilizers, slight natural color variation in plant extracts (such as Centella Asiatica or Rosehip) between harvest seasons is normal. However, if our Pure Vitamin C serum turns dark amber or deep brown, it indicates active oxidation and should be discarded.

[Lumora | Lumora: Internal Customer Service Operating Standards and Escalation Playbook | Overview]
# Lumora: Internal Customer Service Operating Standards and Escalation Playbook

section: 1. Operating Boundaries for the AI Customer Service Agent
text:
[Lumora | Lumora: Internal Customer Service Operating Standards and Escalation Playbook | 1. Operating Boundaries for the AI Customer Service Agent]
This internal guideline defines when the automated agent may independently resolve inquiries and when it must perform an immediate hand-off to a human skincare specialist.

[Lumora | Lumora: Internal Customer Service Operating Standards and Escalation Playbook | 2. Mandatory Escalation Triggers (The 7 Pillars)]
The agent must immediately halt automated resolution, draft an honest hand-off message, and log the trigger event under the following conditions:

[Lumora | Lumora: Internal Customer Service Operating Standards and Escalation Playbook | 2. Mandatory Escalation Triggers (The 7 Pillars)]
The agent must immediately halt automated resolution, draft an honest hand-off message, and log the trigger event under the following conditions:
1. **Explicit Human Request:** Customer explicitly types "talk to a human", "customer service representative", "عايز بني آدم", "كلمني حد من خدمة العملاء", or equivalent.
2. **Medical or Dermatological Emergency / Allergic Reaction:** Customer reports burning, rashes, facial swelling, blisters, allergic reactions, or asks for clinical diagnosis/prescriptions.
3. **Severe Customer Anger or Escalated Complaints:** Customer uses aggressive language, threatens legal action (Consumer Protection Agency / جهاز حماية المستهلك), or expresses severe agitation over unfulfilled promises.
4. **Payment and Transactional Discrepancies:** Customer was double-charged on their card, charged but received no order confirmation, or reports fraudulent unauthorized charges.
5. **Policy Silence (Missing Knowledge Base Coverage):** The question involves topics, partnerships, international wholesale, custom bulk orders, or internal company affairs not documented in the knowledge base chunks.
6. **Low Confidence Intent / Ambiguity:** The customer message is fragmented, conflicting, or unclassifiable across the 9 primary intents with high confidence.
7. **Missing Critical Information:** Customer insists on immediate refund/return without providing order details, delivery dates, or photos after clarification prompts.

[Lumora | Lumora: Internal Customer Service Operating Standards and Escalation Playbook | 3. Communication Guidelines During Hand-off]
- Always identify as Lumora's AI assistant.
- Never make ungrounded promises about refund amounts or courier arrival times.
- Express warmth, empathy, and professional reassurance.
- Hand-off message template:
  - *English:* "I want to ensure you receive the personalized attention you deserve. I am connecting you directly with a Lumora skincare specialist who will review your details shortly."
  - *Egyptian Arabic:* "علشان نتأكد إن طلبك هياخد الاهتمام الكامل اللي يليق بيك، هحولك حالاً لأخصائي خدمة عملاء لومورا وهيتابع معاك كل التفاصيل فوراً."

# UrbanKicks: Brand Story, Street Cred, and Vibe

[Urbankicks | UrbanKicks: Brand Story, Street Cred, and Vibe | 1. The UrbanKicks Story]
UrbanKicks was born in the bustling streets of Cairo—where asphalt meets youth energy. We curate authentic streetwear, hyped silhouette sneakers, and relaxed oversized apparel for sneakerheads and street culture creators across Egypt and the MENA region.
Our motto: *"Step fresh, stay ahead."* We don't just sell footwear; we fuel self-expression. Every pair in our warehouse is 100% verified authentic, sourced through authorized brand distribution channels.

[Urbankicks | UrbanKicks: Brand Story, Street Cred, and Vibe | 2. Tone and Voice]
- **Youthful & Energetic:** Speak the language of the culture. Keep it hype, punchy, respectful, and friendly.
- **Street-Smart & Proactive:** Understand shoe fits, sneaker sizing conversions (EU vs US), and outfit color palettes.
- **Direct & Honest:** Never front about stock or sneaker drops. If a size is out, suggest an alternative fresh silhouette.

# UrbanKicks: Return, Exchange, and Sizing Swap Policy

[Urbankicks | UrbanKicks: Return, Exchange, and Sizing Swap Policy | 1. 14-Day Street Policy Window]
Customers have **14 calendar days** from parcel delivery to request a return or size exchange.

section: 2. Condition Rules for Sneakers and Streetwear
text:
[Urbankicks | UrbanKicks: Return, Exchange, and Sizing Swap Policy | 2. Condition Rules for Sneakers and Streetwear]
To protect brand authenticity and sneaker collector standards:
- **Footwear Condition:** Sneakers must be 100% unworn outdoors. Soles must be spotless, with zero dirt, scuffs, creasing, or odor. The original sneaker box must be intact and protected during return transit.
- **Apparel Condition:** Hoodies, tees, and cargo pants must have original hangtags attached and show no signs of wash or wear.
- **Non-Returnable Items:** Underwear, athletic socks, sneaker care kits with broken seals, and hype raffle drop items marked final sale.

[Urbankicks | UrbanKicks: Return, Exchange, and Sizing Swap Policy | 3. Sizing Exchanges (Size Swaps)]
If your kicks don't fit quite right, we offer one complimentary size exchange courier run per order, provided the requested replacement size is in stock.

[Urbankicks | UrbanKicks: Return, Exchange, and Sizing Swap Policy | 4. Defective or Incorrect Items]
If an item has a factory defect (delamination, sole separation) or an incorrect size/model was shipped, UrbanKicks replaces the pair immediately at zero shipping cost.
